description.value: Hawksworth Restaurant is a landmark fine-dining destination housed within the historic Rosewood Hotel Georgia in downtown Vancouver, earning placement on the LA LISTE Top 1,000 Best Restaurants in the World in both 2025 and 2026. Chef David Hawksworth's contemporary Canadian cuisine is presented across three distinct dining rooms — a cocktail bar and lounge, the pearl room, and the art room — each reimagined by Studio Munge. The restaurant also operates private dining venues accommodating up to 52 guests and offers a range of weekday and weekend dining experiences.
